cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: No Trouble at All
cards.instruction: Remain gracious and accommodating while making your growing inconvenience impossible to miss.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Of course your brother can stay for dinner. I'll give him my pie.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Please don't worry. There are peas, and I had a substantial breakfast.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll order you a pizza. It takes forty minutes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: How thoughtful. I'll keep everyone company while they eat, then you can all watch me have dinner at nine.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 decides and A3 delays questions, but A5 ordinary thanks and accommodation do not sustain approval over B practical solution.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 A hunger causes A3 peas-and-breakfast reassurance; B4 delayed pizza causes A5 graciously visible late eating, after unrelated restriction.

relationship.evidence: B2 notices A cost and B4 proposes a remedy, keeping B considerate rather than exploitative by default.

heightening.evidence: B4 solution extends the inconvenience into waiting while others eat and then being watched eating alone.

specificity.evidence: A1 extra brother and given pie, B2 A has not eaten and B4 forty minutes establish the sacrifice.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 everyone-watches dinner is earned by B4 wait, but the A3 stock question ban jars with graciousness.
